run.executedVia: Playwright runner, no browser: ServiceNow read over cnit and the Scripted REST API as sf.integration, Salesforce read over the sf CLI and anonymous Apex against the deployed classes. Every case reads both sides.

case.title: Full mirror parity by record, not by count

steps.text: Read every CAF Request and CAF Task from ServiceNow.
Read every mirrored record from Salesforce.
Compare as sets of numbers, then separately as sets of sys_id.

records.label: Salesforce requests
records.query: sf data query --query "SELECT SN_Number__c, ServiceNow_Sys_Id__c FROM CAF_Request__c ORDER BY SN_Number__c" --target-org caf-sf

records.label: Salesforce tasks
records.query: sf data query --query "SELECT SN_Number__c, ServiceNow_Sys_Id__c FROM CAF_Task__c ORDER BY SN_Number__c" --target-org caf-sf

observations: Baseline for this run: 132 requests and 165 tasks in ServiceNow. TEST-CASES-INTEGRATION.md records 19 and 30; HANDOFF section 3 records 19 and 28.
expected: Requests and tasks are set-for-set identical across both platforms, compared by number.
The same holds compared by sys_id / ServiceNow_Sys_Id__c.
The symmetric difference is empty in both directions, for both object types.
actual: Requests — ServiceNow 132, Salesforce 132. By number: 0 ServiceNow-only, 0 Salesforce-only. By sys_id: 0 ServiceNow-only, 0 Salesforce-only.
Tasks — ServiceNow 165, Salesforce 165. By number: 0 ServiceNow-only, 0 Salesforce-only. By sys_id: 0 ServiceNow-only, 0 Salesforce-only.
case.verdictReason: Symmetric difference empty in both directions, by number and by sys_id, for requests and tasks.
